description: This PHP class 'TextHelperService' provides utility string functions such as length calculation, substring containment, prefix, and suffix checks. It includes fallback implementations for functions if they are unavailable, ensuring broader compatibility across PHP versions.

classes.name: TextHelperService
classes.description: A utility class offering string manipulation functions with compatibility fallbacks.

methods.name: strLength
methods.description: Calculates the length of a string with optional encoding support, using mb_strlen if available, otherwise falling back to strlen.

methods.name: strContains
methods.description: Checks if a needle exists in a haystack, using str_contains if available, otherwise strpos fallback.

methods.name: strStartsWith
methods.description: Checks if a haystack starts with a given needle, using str_starts_with if available, otherwise strncmp fallback.

methods.name: strEndsWith
methods.description: Checks if a haystack ends with a given needle, using str_ends_with if available, otherwise substr_compare fallback.
